description: This file defines functions to build model provider configuration objects for BytePlus models, exporting two functions: buildBytePlusProvider and buildBytePlusCodingProvider. It imports type definitions and configuration data, and uses helper functions to generate the models array.

methods.name: export function buildBytePlusProvider(): ModelProviderConfig { buildBytePlusProvider
methods.description: Returns a ModelProviderConfig object configured with BytePlus base URL, API type, and models generated from BYTEPLUS_MODEL_CATALOG.

methods.name: export function buildBytePlusCodingProvider(): ModelProviderConfig { buildBytePlusCodingProvider
methods.description: Returns a ModelProviderConfig object configured with BytePlus coding base URL, API type, and models generated from BYTEPLUS_CODING_MODEL_CATALOG.
